description.la: Hortulus rosarum de valle lacrimarum: duodeviginti capitula de bona societate, de sancta solitudine, de poenitentia, de passione Christi et de caelesti patria. Textus ex editione Pohl (1918), versio Anglica anni 1867.
description.en-US: The first of Thomas's two companion garden books, in eighteen short chapters on good company, silence, repentance, the Passion and the heavenly homeland, each opening on a scripture verse. The Latin is Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1918), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; the English is the anonymous 1867 Baltimore translation.
description.pt-BR: O primeiro dos dois livros-jardim de Tomás, em dezoito capítulos curtos sobre a boa companhia, o silêncio, a penitência, a Paixão e a pátria celeste.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Hortulus rosarum, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1918), Opera omnia IV; archive.org raw OCR (Pohl 1918 volume).
sources.description: The eighteen chapters of the Hortulus rosarum. Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical footnotes and introduction are not imported. Chapter titles are Pohl's upper-case titles recased (u/v normalised by script). Raw OCR: drop capitals at chapter openings and isolated letters are often garbled.

sources.edition: The Little Garden of Roses and Valley of Lilies, anonymous English translation (Baltimore: Murphy 1867); archive.org OCR.
sources.description: The eighteen chapters of the Hortulus, matched chapter by chapter with the Latin. The English prints each chapter's Latin scripture motto and its translation. Raw OCR with residual slips.
